title: A renewal or cancel at the desk can fail to reach the door machine, and nobody is told
what: After a sale, renewal, freeze, cancel or archive, the admin app notes that the member's door access changed and sends the update to the door machine from that open page. The note is kept only in the page's memory. If the page is closed before the machine list has loaded, the note is lost. If sending fails, the only trace is a hidden developer log line, and the send is not tried again until some other member is changed. Nothing on any screen says an update was owed, sent or not sent. A member who just renewed can stay locked out, or a cancelled member can keep coming in, until the next daily check, which itself needs a desk to open the app. Not live yet (the door machine part is hidden).
expected: Each owed door update is saved on the server the moment the desk makes the change, retried by itself until it is sent, and the owner's machine page shows any update still waiting or failed.
who: owners and members of gyms with a door machine
how_often: whenever the page closes early or a send fails
fix_line: Save owed door updates on the server, retry them there, and show waiting or failed ones on the machine page

title: 'Paid online, receipt not made' stays on Today after the desk saves the payment by hand
what: When an online payment cannot become a receipt by itself (the plan was removed, it is more than is due, or the person joined without Approve), Today lists it and asks the desk to save it by hand and then tap I saved it. If the desk saves the payment on the member page but does not come back to tap I saved it, the item never leaves: every check works the reason out again, and a hand-saved payment does not change it. Every desk keeps seeing a payment that was already dealt with, and may save it a second time.
expected: Once a matching payment is saved for that member and plan, the item leaves Today by itself, or the card says plainly that only I saved it clears it.
who: front desk and owners using online payments
how_often: each stuck online payment saved by hand
fix_line: Clear the item when a matching hand-saved payment appears, or ask to match it when the desk saves
